editorial:
Imagine two people who are completely different on the outside but exactly the same on the inside. You get to follow a flashy social climber in LA who cares way too much about his brand and a messy podcaster in Ohio who thinks he is a genius. It is a mockumentary, so it feels like you are watching a real behind-the-scenes show. The vibe is awkward and hilarious because both guys are so full of themselves that they cannot see how ridiculous they look. You will find yourself laughing at their failures while wondering how two people from different worlds can be so similarly annoying.

The acting is spot on and the pacing keeps you hooked without feeling too slow. While some of the jokes might feel a bit mean, that is where the magic is. If you like seeing people get humbled, you will love this. To get the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the funny facial expressions. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a movie night with friends who love a good laugh.
endingExplained: Everything crashes down when the two comedians finally meet at a big comedy festival. They try to outdo each other, but their egos cause a huge public fight that goes viral for all the wrong reasons. Instead of becoming stars, they both get canceled by their fans. The movie ends with them both back at square one, still acting like they are better than everyone else despite having nothing left.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cringe comedy and seeing arrogant people fail.
